behaviors.description: Repair preserves explicit pins without pinning automatic dependencies.
behaviors.preconditions: App A depends on an unpinned runtime; a different installed runtime branch is explicitly pinned. Before reinstall-all, unlink only the app's public deployment executable, retaining its repository object.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary and reinstall-all repair preserve the exact pin set and commits; forced repair restores the independent app executable and execution; unused cleanup removes the dependency but retains the pinned control.

surface_assertions.rationale: Forced redeployment preserves pins and does not turn an automatic dependency into a protected runtime.

mappings.rationale: Pin preservation is a focused repair regression, not proof of damaged-object recovery.
